breakdown.description: Method section specifies dt=0.0005 with 480 steps, which does not match the requested final time T=0.2.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly stated that 480 time steps of dt=0.0005 would reach the final time T=0.2 (480 * 0.0005 = 0.24). The ground truth corrected this to 400 time steps. The agent repeated the error, stating '...a total of 480 time steps to reach T=0.2'.
